verdict.rationale: Weave documents per-call token usage and cost tracking, and it groups traces into Threads and sessions. Nothing in the pack shows attaching custom metadata such as user IDs or feature tags to calls, or attributing and aggregating cost by user, session, or feature. Per-call cost plus session grouping are separate, adjacent features, so they earn no credit for metadata-based cost attribution.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attribute cost and usage to users, sessions, and features via custom metadata
